_comment: Corrections to registered metadata, keyed by DOI. Each one records the value
that is registered now, and the value to print instead. references.py refuses
to apply an override whose 'registered' value no longer matches, so when a
publisher corrects a record this file fails loudly instead of printing a
Nothing belongs here that cleaning handles on its own. HTML entities and
inline markup are an encoding and are removed mechanically. This file is for
registrations that are wrong: a title beginning mid-word, an author whose
whole name sits in the family field, a journal name registered incorrectly.
Each entry must also carry 'source': where the correct value was read.
One entry on 2026-11-07, found by the seed comparison on the first run.

10.1148/radiol.11101800.source: PubMed PMID 21502387 (MEDLINE record for Radiology 2011;259(2):311-6), read 2026-11-07. The manuscript's own reference list, written before any of this, carries the same title.
10.1148/radiol.11101800.reason: The registered title has lost two spaces around the word that the published title sets in italics: Crossref carries 'They AreNotthe Same Thing'. Printing the registered string would put a non-word in the reference list of a paper whose subject is that very distinction.

title.registered: CT Dose Index and Patient Dose: They AreNotthe Same Thing
title.display: CT dose index and patient dose: they are not the same thing
